reviewContext.scope: re-verification of prior 12 FAIL findings against current disk state, fresh context, plus adversarial hunt for regressions introduced by the fix pass
reviewContext.toolLimitation: This review environment provides only Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob (no Bash tool). All 'bash -n' parse checks and quote-balance checks were done by static/manual analysis (character-count of quote characters via Grep -o, tracing control flow by reading) rather than by literally executing bash -n or launchctl list. This is noted per-finding where it affects confidence.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: 5-min interactive-menu detection in healthcheck-lib.sh replacing 26h-only backstop
priorFindingsResolution.note: Architecture improved (case (b), healthcheck-lib.sh:35-40, launchd StartInterval=300 confirmed), but the detection regex includes 'esc to (cancel|interrupt)', which is Claude Code's standard active-generation status line, not an idle-only marker. Zero test coverage exists to prove this does not false-positive on a healthy, actively-working long-running pass. See NEW FIND-014.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: RESULT marker file written by the spawned fixer
priorFindingsResolution.note: self-fix.sh never reads back or independently validates the RESULT file; the same LLM that performs the fix is the sole grader of its own SUCCESS/FAIL claim. See NEW FIND-015.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: explicit ground-truth + git rev-parse/remote -v discovery instructions in self-fix.sh TASK step 4
priorFindingsResolution.note: self-fix.sh:36 gives concrete ground truth (~/.openclaw=anicca-dais private, ~/anicca=anicca public) and a discovery method rather than a guess. Residual risk: unenforced (same root cause as FIND-003/FIND-015 -- no post-commit check confirms the LLM actually obeyed), but the design pattern itself is sound and matches this org's build-agents-not-hardcode-decisions doctrine.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: MAX_FIXER_MIN=45 stale-guard: kill+respawn a hung fixer instead of permanent skip
priorFindingsResolution.note: self-fix.sh:16-26 verified: age_min computed from STARTMARK, hung fixer (age>=45min) is killed and replaced; STARTMARK correctly rewritten at line 40 on every real spawn.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: give-up path calls self-fix.sh directly instead of writing a dead note
priorFindingsResolution.note: healthcheck-lib.sh _selffix() (lines 20-23) does `bash .../self-fix.sh $LOOP "$1"`; wired into both the restart-backoff give-up path (line 27) and the output-staleness give-up path (line 59).

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: verify-loops.sh actually curls the recorded URL
priorFindingsResolution.note: liveurl() (verify-loops.sh:12-16) does a real `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 12 -L` and classifies LIVE/DEAD by status code. Minor caveat: see NEW FIND-019 (grabs the last URL anywhere in the file, not necessarily from the newest record).
reddit-loop/loop.sh:28-33 computes POST_FRESH with a 48h threshold and surfaces REDDIT-POSTS-STALE in STATUS. Untested though -- see NEW FIND-018.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: output-staleness escalation (healthcheck-lib.sh case (d)) replacing the unconditional heartbeat touch as the sole health signal
priorFindingsResolution.note: Resolved for capafy and reddit (both wire HC_OUTPUT to a real artifact and both healthcheck plists are actually present under ~/Library/LaunchAgents with StartInterval=300). NOT resolved for life-manager-loop: HC_OUTPUT is deliberately unset there, and the documented compensating control (verify-loops.sh) is not wired into any launchd plist or cron job (grep confirmed zero matches). See NEW FIND-016.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: count() no longer double-prints '0\n0' on an empty/missing file
priorFindingsResolution.note: verify-loops.sh:9 and reddit-loop/loop.sh:13 both capture grep -c into a local var before echoing a single value; correct fix, confirmed via manual trace of both call sites.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: one shared healthcheck-lib.sh instead of 3 byte-identical copies
priorFindingsResolution.note: capafy/life-manager/reddit healthcheck.sh are now ~12-line thin wrappers that source healthcheck-lib.sh and set HC_* env vars; confirmed by reading all three.

priorFindingsResolution.claimedFix: reddit loop no longer covertly bypasses signup CAPTCHA; honest human=compute relay instead
priorFindingsResolution.note: reddit-loop-cli.sh STARTUP and reddit-loop/loop.sh HEAL message both explicitly forbid covert auto-bypass and specify a one-time human relay for that single step while the loop proceeds autonomously otherwise; no CapSolver/tier-a-bypass reference remains anywhere in reddit-loop/*.

evidence.description: Interactive-menu detection added and launchd-scheduled every 5min (plist StartInterval=300, confirmed), a real architectural fix -- but the pattern's core string 'esc to interrupt' is the standard active-generation UI marker, not idle-only, and there is zero test asserting it does not false-positive on real work.
FIND-005 hung-fixer stale-guard verified correct via STARTMARK epoch math.
FIND-007 real curl-based liveurl() verified for capafy and reddit.
FIND-010 count() fix verified correct in both locations by manual trace.
FIND-011 dedup to healthcheck-lib.sh verified (byte-identical copies eliminated).

FIND-012 verified resolved: explicit prohibition on covert CAPTCHA auto-bypass, honest human=compute relay carve-out, and a non-covert fallback path (self-promo-welcome subs) that keeps the loop acting autonomously. Grep for CapSolver/tier-a-bypass in reddit-loop/* returns no matches.
